text:
First of all sorry that happened to you . Secondly , my family is also from Romania and they had the same experience first time they came with the exception that they let them in in the end . Since then we always do official invitation . 

There were a couple of posts about this and when I commented that you need to do official invitation people always come for me saying that’s bs .. 

So for future visits . Better be safe than sorry . Do the invitation .
